reviews.review_description: From meeting the salesperson until the installation,  Suntrix kept us informed every step of the way, either with a phone call or email.I would certainly recommend Suntrix.

Michael managed the initial quote and was very responsive to all my questions and didn't hesitate to change the brand of the panels after I sought some advice from Solar Quotes. They negotiated on price each time I asked, and Michael was very quick to answer any other questions. The time between signing and installation was super short. I think I was expecting the whole process to be a lot more drawn out, but the two installers (Brodie and Brodie) were excellent. They worked hard all day to finish the panels and battery, rather than having to come back for a second day. They provided some very sound advice on the location of the battery which saw me change my original plan. (this advice was also supported by a friend in the Fire Service, so i was very grateful to Brodie for his insight).I absolutely love the set up, its neat and unobtrusive and panels are not actually visible from the street at all, not that I was concerned about that.The system is only newly installed so i'm yet to see a bill, but hopefully there is a significant reduction from where we were.

From first contact to completion of the system, everything was very transperant and clearly explained. The sales Manager went into every possible detail when asked and was able to draft up the best possible system for my house. The installers where excellent, curteous, helpfull and very professional. Suntrix was able to organise a electricity provider which offered an excelkent deal for me.

Sales quoting process was excellent, great engagement and follow up by the salesman. Talked me through the process really wellCustomer service was excellentInstallation was ok, works were re-scheduled on the day due to wet weather a few days prior - could have been more pro-active. Installers were polite and considerate once onsite
Quoting service was excellentQuality of installation was very well done and extremely neat and tidyCustomer service was excellent, answered every question with clarity and detail.
Overall, a very good experience. A little slow in responding at times but things have improved since then.

Suntrix was a very professional company. They suggested where to put the panels so we could get maximum solar power using different parts of our roof. They also put the panels up on the day they said they would.They came out and explained the system. Suntrix has been around for a long time and being a SA company we were happy to go with them.

Suntrix customer service is completely none existent.What I am about to tell you is just so unprofessional and unbelievable.I have been waiting for a replacement solar panel under warranty from Suntrix   (are you ready for it) ....3 years 4 monthsOnly to receive a message that panels have arrived and when I contact them for a confirmation date...yes you guessed it! The response was....Sorry the panels delivered to their store are not your panel model.Exactly what they said to me 3 years ago when I rang to confirm a replacement date...mirror image response.What makes this experience even worse is these panels are freely available here in Australia .Suntrix's feedback is ...they are locked into their Warranty Policy and will continue to communicate with their overseas supplier.My ridiculous patients has had enough and Consumer Affairs will step next week if a genuine date to replace this "one panel" is not given in writing !!I think the last 3years has aged me 10 years...lol !Geoff.

The SunTrix sales experience was quite good. A friendly knowledgeable sales associate helped us make a decision about what type and size of system to get. Their recommendations lined up with the research we'd done so we decided to go for it and gave them a deposit for the system.In hindsight without a firm install date I wouldn't make that mistake again. "We will get to you as soon as possible" and "you are next in line" turned into 3 months later we had our system installed.Other notable things are instead of using standard wireless connections to the internet for monitoring we ended up with a box called a MyWatt. It seems to be a SunTrix proprietary box that is acting as a wifi bridge. Except unlike a normal wifi bridge any issues with it requires contacting SunTrix. Another had I have known I would have waved it off instead the installers wacked it up on the wall, with double sided tape that fell off a few days later, and it showed up on our invoice.Lastly, a portion of our roof is nearly flat and that portion ended up with 6 panels. Hopefully if Adelaide ever gets rain again they'll clean themselves up a bit because now 2 months out from the system being brand new 6 out of 20 panels are coated in dust and grit.The system itself seems to be working fairly well but knowing what I know now I would not engage SunTrix to install another one or recommend them to anyone.
Whilst not the cheapest of the quotes received, the quality of components combined with technical knowledge, service & installation made Suntix a standout for us

This exercise has coincided with me being very ill.   For several reasons, not least, Suntrix are on about their 6th installation in my retirement village meant their rep was able to give me a lot of help.

Gday Finn.We are very happy with the whole procedure except one thing which no one tells you ,on the day the system goes in and its up and running they tell you that it has to go off until new electric meter goes in  ( because existing meter goes backwards  at 100 miles an hour)That takes about another month.Now we knew we would have to wait for new meter, But thought the supplier would get free power for a month.After installation friends and family with solar systems all said  Oh yeah that happened to us, but said nothing about it before.Thankyou for your interesting and informative advice.The three companies you recommended were all good ,But Suntrix advice and help and flexability in different options won our business.
Very very happy with Suntrix service

Suntrix offers a voucher incentive if you recommend their system to someone who installs their solar panels. Good luck with that, I have contacted them on 3 occasions and still waiting. Makes you feel uneasy if you may have a problem in the future with your panels.

Suntrix have been great to deal with, right through from initial quote and consult to finalising the hardware required and ETSA approvals. Feedback and communication during the process since sign up has been very friendly and hassle free. Thanks also to Finn Peacock for providing an unbiased view and guidance on the solar energy system in general.

Suntrix was the only company to get back through you, I contacted others myself and some were good to speak to and others were, how can I say it, just a pain. Suntrix went out of their way to be helpful and although the installation is still to happen, I can`t for see any issues. If I could give them a star rating at this stage it`s 11/10.

Suntrix were professional, available and took the time to look at our unusual situation.As a result, the system is working above expectation. Though, the inverter is installed too high for the vertically challenged to read.We have recommended them to friends and family.
So far, all promises have been fulfilled, and very professionally so.  Waiting on meter change now.

Suntricks! 5 months to get it up and running (after being told it would only take 2 months)! I paid my deposit for my system at the end of August 2013 and only got an acknowledgment from Suntrix 2 weeks later. I then asked when my system was likely to get installed and they eventually told me mid October. By the middle of November my system was still not installed, and after many cancellations, they finally installed it at the end of November, however, they will not be able to get it turned on and fully operational until February 2014. That means it's been a little over 5 months between paying the deposit and getting solar power to my house (assuming they do actually get it turned on in February).I would not recommend Suntrix if you are a person that likes customer service and like to be kept up to date with what is happening with your system. Frequently I would get told I would hear from them on a certain date, and never would. They wouldn't return calls, and didn't really seem to know what they were doing. To be honest, I think they have too much work to handle at the moment and they can't keep on top of it all.

Suntrix seem to be a professional and responsive outfit.  They answered my queries promptly, made all the arrangements in good time, and their installers carried out their work carefully and diligently.  I'm very pleased with the installation.
Not really apart from that I was very happy with the responsiveness of your service as it led me to providers quickly and appropriately. Many thanks
My own fault but inverter is a bit too high on wall for me to read easily

Suntrix made contact within 2 hours of filling out the request on solar quotes (2 of 3 companies responded). The installation was a week beyond the time frame given but SA has a feed in tariff ending this month so companies are busier.The down side is the 4 week delay between installation and  SA Power Network changing over our meter caused by our electricity company.Suntrix put the request through promptly to them at the start, SAPower Network processed the request the day after they received advice of the new electricity quote and Suntrix booked the application the day after, but in between, Energy Australia sat on the paperwork for 31/2 weeks.

Very happy with all aspects of the purchase, have recommended to friends who were  alsovery happy with Sun Trix quote and service and particularly the panels and inverter. They decided on a 6kW system as they have young adults at home.Thank you for your great website, it helped us decide what we needed to look for and the questions to ask.
We purchased the unit from ACE Solar and Electrical, as there was some extra electrical work that needed to be completed on our new home.
The service and installation was excellent.
Very happy with service to date.

Every aspect of SunTrix's service was efficient and professional from the salesperson, installers and office staff.  Even changeover to a new meter was quick and handled for us. Haven't had the system n long yet but very happy with the choice we have made.

Your service is brilliant and although Suntrix was the first company through the door they ticked all the boxes for my requirements by the ocean, quality of supporting brackets and panels and guarantees.Thanks so much. I didn't know where to start and I have total peace of mind with my choice.

Looking for a solar energy system is not easy for a lay person. We were quite confused with all the options available.Thanks to you we received a Quote and advice from Suntrix. Suntrix took care of advising our energy supplier and also making an appointment for SA Power Networks.Suntrix installed our system within a week, but we had to wait a month for SA Power Network to connect us to the grid.
Of the three companies you gave us Suntrix contacted us within hours the others took days.
Suntrix are excellent to deal with.

The salesman was friendly and helpful. The installers were prompt and efficient, explaining just what they would do etc. My only criticism was that their office management was not as efficient as their salesman and installers - but maybe my expectations on that score are too high, having worked in an office for 25 years!

Overall, good so far - but I have yet to turn the system on - still waiting for my meter from SA Networks.I appreciated having someone come out onsite and provide me with a firm quote, even when the installers found that the system was not quite suitable for my house the company still honoured the quote.

The installers (contractors) were efficient and well skilled and deployed the system quickly.from quote to installation it took approximately one week (midway through December - Christmas period). Some of the back office procedures with the supplier had hiccups non too serious.Their staff is always courteous and obliging. I had two identical systems (2 x 4.75 KW) installed on two properties three days apart and in each case the workmanship was of a high standard. I have setup my own monitoring (sampling power production statistics from the inverter at 4 sec intervals, and the efficiency with just over a month's worth of data (and in summer of course) seems to be within spec so far.I would and do  recommend this company (Suntrix) to would be solar clients. I would also highly recommend the SolarQuotes web site - and encourage you to read ALL the information on this site (a very good primer on the solar infrastructure and research other sites as well). I went from zero understanding to having enough knowledge to stave off some very "dodgy" company recommendations by being able to do my own calculations and understand the implications of the technical specs on power production in a very short space of time.Finally all the kudos to Finn Peacock who had the foresight to set up such an invaluable web site - thanks.

Our system is only new so hard to rate above good for value and quality but so far we are very happy with the whole experience.One of the reasons we chose Suntrix was that they were prepared to put in writing that the system would be installed before the rebate finished.  The installation was painless and efficient.We are not yet connected to the grid but our meter is running backwards!!  And it's been really hot so air con on heaps.
Great experience dealing with Sun Trix from start to finish.

Very pleased with Dawood (Salesperson).  He was the most professional, polite, courteous and knowledgeable.I contacted 6 companies to discuss quotes and Dawood was by far the most impressive representative (followed very closely by Solahart).  One Rep was only after a quick sell and after 5 minutes on the phone asked if I wanted to purchase there and then. When I replied no, I wanted additional information he referred me to the website.I 'interview' tradies to ensure I gain an understanding of what I require, ensure they understand what I require and they give me 'good vibes'.  Dawood ticked all the boxes and provided extremely helpful information to assist me with my decision making.

We were impressed with Suntrix and Blu Sky, but not so much with Mark Group.We chose Suntrix because the consultant Adam Crickmar was very knowledgeable and of course, theirprice was very competitive.We were also very happy with the installers.

Unable to rate quality of system as we are waiting on AGL supplying a new meter box.We chose to use Suntrix solely on the expertise of the salesman.  He really was fantastic, much more knowledgeable and thorough than the other salespeople that quoted.

Prompt response to the request for a quote. No fuss, no pressure sales person. Local business so my partner was able to go and speak to personnel at their work site for more details.The solar quotes website alerted us to potential issues like asbestos so that the sales person was able to deal with this upfront and check if there could be any problems related to this issue.Installers were efficient and prompt. Import/export meter installed same day.Well pleased with result. Now for some sunshine!

The salesman was very pleasant, upfront and knowledgeable, answering all questions we put to him. He was not pushy at all.The installers were efficient, cheerful and obviously competent. They took time to explain the workings of the inverter readings and the meter box.The Head Office has been a bit slow with the paperwork, but this is probably because they are under pressure from the obvious demand on their services, given the move to reduce the Government grants.
Our sales person was Tony and he was great. He was the only sales guy who was actually honest and didn't just talk his way through to make his panels look better.
Customer service was great and sales person was very knoledgeable and helped me understand the workings of solar

I am happy with the supplier & installers, proof of quality & customer service to follow.Contract was signed 25/9/12 installed 15/11/12.ETSA metre converted prior to installation of system which enable same to be up & running same day.

For those who like detail: system size 10 kW, price $17,686, 40 x250 watt (Simax SM660-250) 2 x 5kw Growatt MTL 5000 inverters.I originally planned to get the SMA inverter, but was told that if it failed, replacement would take significantly longer as they did not keep a spare 10 kW on standby. The 5 kW Growatt being cheaper and used in many installs meant next day replacement.We have some shade loss - 15 %, and orientation loss of 6% and very low pitched roof, more loss.Anyway, the first day which had thin clouds surprised me, 60.5 kw generated and still an hour or so of light left...P.S. THIS WEBSITE HELPED ME UNDERSTAND SOLAR.

SunTrix were a fantastic company to deal with and I would happily recommend them to anyone.  The staff, including the installers, were friendly and informative and offered an excellent service and product.

The Suntrix people have all been pleasant to deal with and  our system is up and running well.  We were pleased that they got ETSA onto our meter changeover quickly - it was done before the panels were installed.

It's been less than a week since installation.  The installation went very well, the guys worked through some very inclement weather to complete the job.  After a few days, I was a little concerned that there was something wrong with 1 of the panels; it seemed to have a milky colour in some light conditions whereas the rest were black.  Anyway, I called SunTrix on Monday morning and they had a couple of guys out by Monday afternoon.  They said that there didn't appear to be anything wrong with the panel, but changed it anyway.  Good job SunTrix.It's a little early to comment on the quality of the system, but I've given it a 'Good' anyway as I feel sure that a company that provides good service like this wouldn't sell junk systems.

The person who gave the quote came out the day I telephoned and we had the system installed within 4 weeks. They are a company that does not advertise as a general rule, finding customers by word of mouth. Someone at work put me on to them. The first company I telephoned, Combined Solar, was the last company to make contact regarding a quote and this was well after we had signed up with SunTrix and not long before our system was installed.

SunTrix was the only supplier that made the effort to visit and inspect the premises regarding suitability.The sales person wasn't pushy and easy to deal with. Communication was also good.Thanks for your help.
Suntrix will actually come out to your house and talk you through their products with no pressure. They will also assess the area where the panels need to be installed
You do hear of some horror stories with Solar and especially installation but everything we have had done by SunTrix has been very good. We are just waiting for the ETSA meter to be installed.

I also had the salesman do a quote for a friend and they also purchased the same size unit as us. He suggested the unit would be installed in 6 to 8 weeks but it was done in 3. The installers were very polite and efficient and the company worked around installation dates and times as my friend and I are both shift workers. Also, the girls in the office were very good in trying to help us and have kept us up to date with the information on meter installations etc. We are now in the process of getting a quote for our son's house.
The salesman  came  to  house  - he  told  me about installation  near  me - and I went  there and  asked them  how they  liked   it  --  very  satisfied.

Compared to the other companies we contacted Suntrix salespeople and installers were the best by far.There were a few hiccups with the billing side of things, but this has been sorted out all ok.Overall, I'd happily use them again and also recommend them to anyone.
Salesman from SunTrix has good knowledge, had roof plan and looked at my meter box. Others did not do anything much at all just flog products they represent SunTrix excelled in my opinion.
Still awaiting etsa to fit smart meter due to be done 11th October.Suntrix did everything very well and installers were good.

The salesman was a no nonsense no crap talking person who really knew his product. Others fumbled through and kept calling the office for help. Was not the cheapest system supplier but absolutely the best. The installation with 24 panels took just under 4 hours and all the guys were company employees not contractors.

The sales person visited my home soon after I requested him.  He was new at the job but quite helpful and not pushy.  My panels were installed yesterday a week earlier than quoted. The installation contractors (3 young men) were very methodical and efficient and the complete install was done in 3 hours. I am most happy with their neat work.Unfortunately I have to wait another month for ETSA to upgrade the meter - they are so busy with applications.

I have been very satisfied with this company.Initial presentation and explanation of product was good and contact regarding progress to installation was good  - installation was two weeks ahead of forecast. Installation was carried out efficiently,and the follow up two weeks later to see if I was satisfied with everything was appreciated

I was very happy with the service and the system was installed at the time that the salesman quoted. They were helpful at the office and answered all the questions I asked. The installer was friendly, prompt and explained the system to us in terms that we understood. All in all it was a very pleasant experience and  hopefully our electricity bill will reduce accordingly.

Had asbestos backing on meter box (etsa walked in then walked off job site) all for 4 screws holes SunTrix went higher up ETSA management chain and after being installed on the 20/06/11, finally the job was completed and connected 28/8/11.

We met the sales person 'Andy' very promptly after his first contact with us. We agreed to a 5kw unit and paid a $1000 deposit with the promise that the installation would take place in approximately 6 wks. After 7 weeks of waiting and no contact from the supplier we contacted them only to discover that we needed to meet the salesman again as there was an issue with the system. When he returned he told us that there was not enough room on our roof for a 5kw system so we had to have a 4kw. We agreed and the price was altered accordingly. Another 3 weeks went by and still nothing? When we went back through the paperwork to get the phone number to make contact again, we discovered that the new 'altered' price was actually $350 more than the original price quoted for a 4kw system-he originally quoted for a 5 and a 4. The salesman came back and again altered the price and as of today, 3wks later still nothing in regard to having an installation date? We are considering getting our deposit back (if that is possible) and using a different company, not a good start to what seemed a promising company-very disappointing indeed.

Suntrix were the first to respond to the request from SolarQuotes, and saw us the next day.Provided a very competitive quote, fortunately for us they had a sale on their 4kW system at the time, which is what we needed.  Salesman was very friendly, knowledgeable, and did not pressure us at all.Only one mark down on customer service as the installation was delayed slightly due to the colour panels we originally wanted being unavailable (logistical problems I believe) so we had to change - no big deal really.The installers were friendly, professional and efficient - the job was done neatly, all things were tidied up and was finished shortly after lunch on the day of installation.Quality of the system is probably too soon to gauge properly but so far so good! (I'm taking daily readings :)  Averaging just over 11kWh generated per day so far after a week and a half (in winter on a NE facing roof). Looking forward to seeing how it will perform in the summer sun (and how our power bill will look!).Overall would definitely recommend Suntrix.

SunTrix were quick to respond. (One of the other 2 quotes did, but by then, it was too late).The price was better than I found anywhere in my own research. SunTrix list and details of their product, was well set out, easy to understand, well explained, low key.The Growatt inverter is "so they say good quality and value" with a 5 yr extendable warranty, within the next 3 yrs, if I want warranty for 10 yrs. I researched, and well... in the end, just took their word for it. We shall see!The panels have a 25 year guarantee. The installation guys were neat, friendly, excellent, quick and explained it all quite well. Only minus: no pay-as-u-go financial plan available. So I just paid up, a small deposit, then the rest when installed.They contacted ETSA, and a week after installation, they arrived.Thanks!

SunTrix were willing to work within our requirements of purchasing an upgradable inverter and installing the panels in two stages to fit within our cash flow. At the time no other company would quote for us to do that. The salespeople were very nice to deal with. No hard sell but very knowledgeable. Good quality installation. We would recommend them to others.

We thought it was a good service, all seems to be working OK, installation went smoothly and operating now. As it is winter time, we have not seen what the system actually puts out in optimum conditions, yet. All in All, Happy with the service and system so far.

Very smooth process from the installlation point of view, still not wired into the grid and to early to say whether the system is efficient yet. Suntrix answered all of my many questions thoroughly and with supporting articles.

They had the quickest response for a quote. They had a well-organised, respectful salesperson. The phone receptionist was excellent for enquiries. Follow-up installation happened as promised in a reasonable time frame. The installation guys were quick, efficient, careful and cheerful. Explanation about cleaning the panels and reading the inverter was clear and helpful. Extended warranty is optional.(Still waiting on ETSA - so any excess goes into the grid for free, so far). SunTrix has no finance repayment plan - you have to pay it all up-front.

The extra  payment of $1000 was of concern especially as I had a signed contract. I was told that the steepness of the roof was the reason as 2 more men were required for the job. I ended up with lighter panels and close to 4.2kW of potential power. My concerns about the Growatt inverter have been lessened especially on being told that I have an improved model. The inverter looks good but connection to the grid is yet to come. The office staff were friendly and sympathetic of my concerns.
Installers were stuffed by bad weather so ended up being a bit disjointed, but that wasn't their fault.  Other than that, faultless service and customer support.  Good people to deal with.
Good communication prior to installation by office staff and installers were very professional and completed the task promptly.

The installation was put off due to poor weather conditions and inadequate assessment of the roof in the first instance, the installer stated that the roof was too slippery for 2 people to handle the installation, which we thought should have been already noted.  There was a distinct lack of communication from the Company as to when installation was going to happen and they just didn't turn up one day at all with no phone call.  Otherwise, we are happy so far with the product.

Suntrix had our system installed within 1-2 weeks. They had the best price for the size system we wanted and the salesman was extremely knowledgeable.They also had the best quality solar panels compared to some of the other companies we looked at.The only thing we are waiting on is our smart meter which is out of Suntrix's control as this is through our electricity providor.All round it was very quick and easy.
I got a special so it was just under $3000. The sales woman wasn't very experienced but very helpful, lovely, and dedicated. Great installers!
Your contacts were slow. One was Mannix who I have used and will never use again.

Finn,     I did email you to thank you for the service you provided with 3 Quotes , and I will be glad to  ans. your "Survey?" but there are a few things I should point out. The Electrician who came to install said that the panels should have been tilted to the correct angle on frames which the representative never mentioned in his estimate, and consequently was not done. Secondly, the fact that my Switch/Meter board had Asbestos in it and the trust wouldn't touch it was not mentioned, this will cost me another $1500 to correct, and had I known this I am not sure I would have proceeded with the job. Thirdly, the Sparky who wired up the unit refused  to connect the inverter to the A/C supply, so that's not finished. (I believe he was scared of the Asbestos, and he never had the appropriate Circuit Breaker, although he did leave me one to go in the "New Board"). I am getting it all finished off next Tuesday by a bloke who seems to know what he is doing and has been very helpful. (I myself was an "A" class Electrician for 40+ years before I retired and stopped paying for my licence which got it confiscated, so I have some idea of what I am talking about.

System installed 7/5/12. Still awaiting documents confirming warranties etc.  A roof tile got a hairline  crack in it during installation ( I do not think this would be unusual) and there has some water damage to a very small section of ceiling due to this. Once I noticed this on 2/6, the installer responded very quickly to repair the tile(4/6). The installer also said he would arrange a painter to repair internally - I am still waiting for this.
Can't provide much feedback yet: we've had the system installed, but ETSA won't be changing the  meter for  another 8 weeks!
Suntrix were incredibly efficient and organised everything. The salesperson, Andy, was knowledgeable and not pushy unlike one of the other salesman from a different company.

The sales rep from Suntrix rang the next day after requesting detail from Solar quotes and came out to see us the following Saturday. The other companies took over a week to respond and quotes varied from an email to seeing people I felt were just salespeople and could not care whether they got our business or not.

All aspects of dealing with SunTrix has been very good from the initial salesperson to the installation team. All correspondence was responded to in a timely manner and within expectations as were the install date and times. Early days but great service and system.

I emailed the 3 companies you reccomended and Suntrix rang the next day. The others took 3 to 5 days to get back and given we live in Murray Bridge it was hard for them work out a time to meet.I then had an issue that we needed the system installed in 4 weeks and Suntrix said they could do it.Adam their sales person was excellent.The guys that installed it (2 days prior to their deadline) were fantastic.Not sure if its a good system as have only had it for 4 weeks but because of my experience with Suntrix 2 of my freinds have ordered one as well.
The salesperson explained exactly what system we were purchasing in an friendly manner with no pressure to purchase from his company.

Suntrix's sales rep was the first to respond to my inquiry. He came out on time, was well presented and knew his product and was able to answer all questions. He recommended a system that so far has met out power needs exactly. Prior to installation, I was called and informed a component that was quoted was unavailable - the 3kw Inverter. I was offered and provided with a more superior upgradable model.  Installation was reasonably prompt and in line with what they stated (in a busy market). The installer was on time, worked hard, explained how it operated and tidied up. I can't complain about any of their service. I would happily recommend them to anyone. Sadly, the others recommended were unprofessional. One failed to turn up to an appointment, I waited, called in and was lied to that he was 'on the way'. He then admitted he forgot the appointment. (I took the day off work). The other company sent out a sales rep that did not know where north was (it got worse after that), he just read the brochure to me, had no idea, then sent in a quote $2000 over the Suntrix one.

Very happy with the whole process from the initial interview with the salesman right up to seeing my meter going backwards. Suntrix actually provided evidence of the efficiency of their system where others just tell you they have the best panels and all others are rubbish without backing it up. Looking forward to never paying an electricity bill again; thanks Suntrix!

Great info from you....looked at it all....one was in W.A. and Suntrix wasn't far away from us. The price was about average for system. My sister in law signed up with them as well on our advice. She got the same as us. Ours has been in about 3 weeks now and with winter is working about average. Nice to see that meter run backwards a lot. The ETSA import/export meter is about 6 weeks behind to fit.

Salesman Dawood  visited the site, Well mannered and informative. Clinton installed the system, Very efficient and well mannered , workmanship appears to be good.  Frankie and Office Staff friendly and answered my silly questions.  Whole process took about 8 weeks which included 4 weeks waiting for my turn for the ETSA meter replacement. Interesting now to see how the system performs.
Excellent service, genuine, friendly salesman. Only ones who actually came to our house and seemed interested in what was best for us not just them. Answered all our questions thoroughly.
No...Only installed today...

The company I chose was in the upper range of suppliers.  I was hoping that their product was there for quality as well.  Not being in the industry, and being a layman, who knows.  Time will tell.  O chose a smaller system becacuse its only me in the house. I have had some issues with water leakage from the installation, mostly not the installers fault, but the tiles on the roof, have had excellent after sales service. BUT, that is from this particular installer, David Miller Electrical and Solar and contracter 0417876746.  would highly recommend him.

Great guys / customer service. Price was very competitive (considering I received 4 other quotes). Very flexible on tailoring the design... very professional installation. Quite flexible on payment terms also... Would highly reccommend SunTrix (especially on larger installations).

A very daunting experience, but the more questions you ask the more you become informed over time.Suntrix were the first to get in contact with us and also prepared to come and see us in our home, so it was good to speak with a representative face to face and not just a voice over the phone.

You are a little early with your questionnaire since the system has been installed only 3 weeks. It all appears to be going OK, but am still awaiting the import/export meter.Suntrix were the only one of the three that bothered to come to look at the installation site. One company responded with an email quote only and the other did not respond at all.
It is a bit early to say how good the system is until we get through some months of sunlight.  I am still waiting for their customer manual.

I have only had the system for a week, and had trouble due to having an old house, so I needed some electrical work done, before they could hook the system up, but it is now operational, and my metre is spinning backwards, which is always a good thing!Suntrix have been efficient and professional and I would recommend them.
